scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.lint:cli: uv run --project packages/cli ruff check packages/cli/agentshield_cli packages/cli/tests
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project apps/api pyright apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.typecheck:cli: uv run --project packages/cli pyright packages/cli/agentshield_cli packages/cli/tests
scripts.test:smoke:panel: uv run --project packages/cli --extra dev pytest tests/smoke/test_panel_local_e2e.py -s
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && pnpm lint:api && pnpm lint:cli
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:cli
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:cli
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:openapi && pnpm check:chinese
